segments.text: Read the dialogue with an elderly woman's low husky contralto,
You fed my children, Ballypeople, so I give you what I do not give to strangers.
The last verse stays with the clan.

text: Read the dialogue with an elderly woman's low husky contralto, dry rasp and quiet authority. You fed my children, Ballypeople, so I give you what I do not give to strangers. Not all of it. The last verse stays with the clan.
